behavior.name: requiredContent
behavior.description: Issuer, balance, heading, instructions, code label and code are non-empty render preconditions; invalid required content omits the complete component.

behavior.name: copyCode
behavior.description: When supplied, target behavior attempts to copy exactly the visible code after native Button activation. The code stays selectable and a pre-existing polite status announces success or selection fallback.

behavior.name: commerceContentBoundary
behavior.description: Targets supply formatted balance/details, capabilities and QR content. P2 does not calculate, refresh, purchase, redeem, associate accounts, generate wallet passes or generate QR payloads.

behavior.name: formComposition
behavior.description: The pilot-only optional form composes canonical Input and Button, preserves native naming and constraint validation, and leaves purpose, endpoint, pending, result, retry and focus policy to the target.

behavior.name: responsiveComposition
behavior.description: P2 responds to its own inline-size container, preserves source order and contains long localized, RTL and unbroken content without a viewport-specific implementation.

properties.name: visual
properties.description: Optional decorative background media; issuer and balance remain visible text when absent.

properties.name: issuer
properties.description: Non-empty visible name of the issuing target.

properties.name: balance
properties.description: Non-empty target-formatted remaining balance; no numeric parsing or currency conversion is inferred.

properties.name: instructions
properties.description: Non-empty visible instructions without an inferred redemption, purchase or lookup workflow.

properties.name: codeLabel
properties.description: Non-empty visible label for the redeemable code.

properties.name: copyLabel
properties.description: Optional visible canonical Button label that enables target-owned copy behavior.

properties.name: details
properties.description: Optional target-supplied semantic facts such as status, expiration, recipient message or initial value.

properties.name: actions
properties.description: Optional target-owned canonical Button compositions without a neutral purchase, redemption, wallet or print default.

properties.name: qr
properties.description: Optional target-supplied QR figure with visible purpose text and a human-readable code alternative.

properties.name: form
properties.description: Pilot-only optional target-owned native form composed from canonical Input and Button; no neutral workflow is implied.

accessibility: Require non-empty issuer, formatted balance, heading, instructions, code label, and code; omit invalid required composition.
Use one document main. Exhibit and Studio render a contextual labelled section; standalone targets supply the main landmark.
Keep optional background media decorative because issuer, balance and instructions remain real text.
Keep the redeemable code selectable independently of Clipboard availability or result.
Use a visible canonical Button label for copy and place feedback in a polite status container that exists before the result update.
Keep target actions native: anchors navigate and buttons act; canonical Button owns focus, keyboard, disabled and busy presentation.
Give optional QR media visible purpose text and preserve the readable code as an equivalent non-visual path.
Any pilot form uses a visible canonical Input label, serializable name, native validation and truthful target feedback.

web.notes: Contextual semantic composition in pages.css; target behavior supplies clipboard, data and optional workflows.

shopify.notes: Dedicated gift_card.liquid maps Shopify balance, state, expiration, code, QR identifier, pass URL, issuer and target copy/print behavior.
